summary.text: Wyman Duggan represents District 12 in the Florida House of Representatives, first elected in 2018, according to the House's official biography.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists Duggan as an attorney from Jacksonville, born in Jacksonville, with a B.A. from The University of the South (1991) and a J.D. from William & Mary (1994).
Duggan served in the United States Marine Corps Reserve from 1993 to 1995.
